axes.name: scanline_size_order
axes.rationale: The original target calls __aFldiv at 0xA6 then __aFlmul at 0xAD, while the preserved candidate calls the two helpers in reverse. Dividing rounded width before multiplying height matches row-stride semantics and the helper order.

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
